_doc: Canonical events for the AUTOPILOT.OI funnel (Master Plan WP04, data model p4). Financial truth is ONLY the Gumroad paid order in state/ledger/events.jsonl. Every other event is a marketing signal. Missing attribution is recorded as 'unknown', never guessed. No names, emails or phone numbers in any analytics or ad payload.

ids.purchase_id: sha256 of the Gumroad sale id (ledger field 'order'); the raw sale id never leaves Gumroad and the private ledger
ids.dedup_key: event_id = '<type>:<purchase_id>' (ledger merge is idempotent: a sale seen twice is stored once)

events.name: page_view
events.status: firing, not readable until GOATCOUNTER_TOKEN is set

events.name: landing_variant_view
events.status: GoatCounter firing; Meta waits for pixel

events.name: checkout_intent
events.status: GoatCounter firing; Meta waits for pixel

events.name: email_optin
events.where: Kit form 10118407 on /brain/ and landing pages
events.status: form live; 0 confirmed subscribers so far

events.name: order_paid
events.where: Gumroad sales API, polled every 3 h by revenue.yml
events.counts_as_sale: true only when test=false and free=false

events.name: refund_processed
events.where: same Gumroad sale object (refunded, partially_refunded, chargedback)
events.status: working (unit tested); never exercised on a real order

events.name: purchase_pixel
events.where: Gumroad receipt page via Gumroad third party analytics
events.status: NOT SET UP: no pixel exists on the ad account

events.name: buyer_onboarding_start
events.status: NOT SET UP: needs Kit UI

events.name: activation
events.where: buyer reaches a first useful draft
events.system: sales/activations.csv (manual from tester or buyer reply)

events.name: ad_spend
events.where: Meta ad account via Adspirer (read only)

retention.kit: Kit is the system of record for email consent; unsubscribes suppress all marketing

consent.email: explicit opt in on the form, source stored in fields.source
consent.sms: not used (plan: email only for 30 days)
consent.ads: no personal data sent to Meta; Gumroad handles the Purchase event on its own receipt
